facts.text: Under the Pack Promise+ program, eligible Nevada undergraduate students receive up to $12,700 in gift aid to help pay for tuition, fees, and books.

sources.title: Pack Promise+ | Free Tuition, Books and Fees for Qualified Students
sources.quote: If you qualify, you'll get up to $12,700 in gift aid (grants and scholarships) to help pay for your 2027-2028 tuition, fees and books.
